rule: Plan 5.4 (AL-2674): anon may execute a SECURITY DEFINER function only when it is listed here. Each listed function is a public read function: STABLE or IMMUTABLE, SET search_path = '', an explicit projection, no dynamic SQL, and its own host, Site, tenant and subject admission; anon still holds no grant on any table or view beneath it. Each entry names the function as the catalog gate prints it (schema.name(identity arguments)), with a reason and its reviewer. scripts/verify/tenant-rls-catalog.mjs enforces the list both ways.

entries.reason: WP3a part 1b (AL-2676): the anonymous verified-host lookup. For a claimed name in state ready or active it returns six outputs, tenant_id, site_id, generation, surfaces, state and is_home, and nothing for any other host; it normalises HTTP spelling only. There is no client grant on the tables beneath it (sites, site_domains, donor_portal_hosts, donor_account_brands).

WP3b part 2 (AL-2676): the anonymous home read behind the redirect of a Site name's account paths to its organization's home. It returns one output, primary_domain, the home record's host, only when the asked name is active and serves website, the same organization's home record names a host other than the asked one, and that host is active and serves donor_account; otherwise nothing. It returns no tenant, Site, generation, status or brand, and reads no status. It normalises HTTP spelling with resolve_verified_host's expression. There is no client grant on the tables beneath it (site_domains, donor_portal_hosts).

entries.reason: WP8a part 2 rest, PR 2a (AL-2681): the anonymous config read of checkout. For an active claimed name serving website with an active Site, or the home record serving donor_account, of an active organization, and 1 to 99 targets (active funds that are not the reserved fee-cover fund, or workers) that all resolve in that organization to one legal entity with an active test-mode binding, it returns one output, connected_account_id; otherwise nothing, the same nothing for every reason. It returns no tenant, Site, entity, binding or status. It normalises HTTP spelling with resolve_verified_host's expression. There is no client grant on the tables beneath it (site_domains, sites, donor_portal_hosts, tenants, funds, missionaries, payment_account_bindings).
